disposition_reason: The original grid-reaching missing-observation experiment has an ordered behavior-correlation endpoint, but its exact curve values, historical ratio grid, session-file/fold identities and masking realizations are not recovered. Methods resolves the retained-versus-dropped ambiguity: rho is retained observations. The existing numerical component and a newly grouped error curve cannot substitute for the Figure 7e and Extended Data 6e–f paper baseline.

source_paper.title: Dynamical flexible inference of nonlinear latent factors and structures in neural population activity

evidence.locator: Figure 7e; Extended Data Figure 6e–f; Methods: 2D grid reaching task, Evaluation using 5-fold cross-validation, Behaviour prediction accuracy—Motor datasets, Inference analyses with missing observations
evidence.supports: Defines grid-reaching behavior prediction, complete temporal support, fivefold evaluation, observed-ratio masks and distinct filtering/smoothing conditions. Full text reviewed through Europe PMC fullTextXML for the same PMCID.

Pearson correlation is calculated per output dimension, stored as float32, then aggregated after the explicit NaN handling; fit/apply z-scoring is separate. Current code lineage does not establish historical Figure 7 parity.

evidence.locator: Version v2 record description; variable names; Supplements session list
evidence.supports: Public source has sorted spikes, cursor position and timestamps for Indy/Loco; identifies seven listed 20160622_01–20160921_01 sessions with raw-data supplements. These listings do not alone establish the exact seven analysis files used by DFINE.

target.description: Predict cursor x/y position and x/y velocity at every test timepoint under source-defined missing neural observations, separately for causal filtering and noncausal smoothing; retain full Figure 7e curves and Extended Data 6e–f comparisons.

dataset.description: The paper uses public O’Doherty/Sabes grid-reaching recordings. Zenodo 3854034 v2 supplies the relevant data family, but exact release/file/hash correspondence to the DFINE analysis remains unbound; the dataset’s unrelated decoder-result CSV is not a DFINE reference.

cohort.description: Seven sessions of Monkey I from 20160622/01 through 20160921/01, right-hemisphere M1, are source specified. Recover the exact seven recording identities and selected neurons before admission; all seven are required and one monkey does not support independent-animal inference.

split.description: Source uses five equal folds per session, training on four and testing on one. Exact ordered folds, temporal alignment and missing-mask realizations/replicates are unrecovered. rho ranges from 0.2 to 1, with exactly (1-rho)*100 observations dropped per 100 steps; full ratio grid and partial-block behavior require binding. A new blocked/held-session split is an extension.

inputs.description: Fully observed training neural activity; test neural activity contains the fixed source masks. Filtering accesses present/past observations only; smoothing may access future observations. Test behavior and dropped neural values remain evaluator-only. The behavioral readout is trained from smoothed training factors.

preprocessing.description: Source specifies top 30 behavior-predictive neurons, 10 ms spike bins, causal Gaussian smoothing with 30 ms SD, 50 ms sampling and training-statistic z-scoring. Historical neuron selection, ordered support and readout/hyperparameter selection need a source-bound implementation; changing those choices must not silently change the published comparison.

metric.description: Behavior Pearson CC on all test times, including missing-neural times: r_d=sum((y_d-mean(y_d))*(p_d-mean(p_d)))/sqrt(sum((y_d-mean(y_d))^2)*sum((p_d-mean(p_d))^2)), then arithmetic mean over four dimensions. Current author code maps NaN correlation to zero before the dimension mean; historical caller parity remains a separate binding gate. Higher is better.

aggregation.description: Figure 7 curves average over sessions and cross-validation folds, with source confidence bounds. All 35 session-fold cells and every original ratio are required for each inference regime; historical mask-replicate handling and numeric curve values are unresolved. The paper does not specify a single integrated loss across ratios.

comparison.primary_metric: Complete source behavior-Pearson-CC curves by observed ratio and filtering/smoothing regime

published_baseline.description: Figure 7e and Extended Data 6e–f identify the required DFINE curves and LDM/SAE controls, but exact source numerical values are not recovered. A p-value, chance level, approximate plot digitization or full-observation score is not the missing curve baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No authentic DFINE fit/inference/reference run is established. Current torchDFINE plus source Methods is a candidate route, pending original session/fold/mask/caller binding and a trustworthy full prediction export.

minimum_effect.rationale: Choose a behavior-CC improvement rule across the full source curve only after recovering reference variability and intended decoding utility. No universal CC margin or integrated-error surrogate is justified here.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired uncertainty for identical source sessions/folds/masks, respecting correlated timepoints and repeated folds; define simultaneous curve decisions before final scoring.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Recording session or defensible within-session temporal unit, conditional on one animal; folds, dimensions and missingness seeds are repeated measurements.
uncertainty.rationale: The paper reports Wilcoxon tests and confidence bounds, but these do not provide a ready uncertainty rule for an improved method or independent animals. The original sampling hierarchy and repeat count must first be recovered.

paper_win_requires: Bind all original seven sessions, five folds, four behavior dimensions, complete ratio grid and mask identities; score every original test timepoint.
Compare a frozen candidate to independently rerun DFINE and the recovered paper curve under identical masks, preprocessing, readout selection and resource/access allowances.

Declare separate filtering and smoothing claims; any future observation used in the filtering path invalidates that claim. Retain LDM and SAE zero/neighbor-average controls at original 0.3/0.6 settings.

Meet the predeclared meaningful improvement and valid uncertainty rule across the original complete endpoint; reproduction, a new integrated-loss scalar, burst-dropout masks or a new split cannot constitute the paper win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison has been verified; the source-paper comparison is specifically DFINE under its original missing-observation assay.

episode.improvement_loop: After source recovery, expose original training data and an inner development policy confined to each source training fold; iterate inference/model choices with identical missingness feedback rules for both access arms.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze algorithm, hyperparameters, neural selection, readout fitting, preprocessing, code/weight hashes, inference regime and every allowed selection rule before any final source-fold result is revealed.
episode.final_evaluation: Run once on the complete bound original support against protected behavior labels and an independently fixed author reference. Public source test data require exposure accounting; changing the split to repair exposure is a separately named extension.
episode.baseline_policy: The trusted comparator is the authenticated source DFINE recipe, not candidate-supplied predictions or a weaker local model. Numerical score equality only calibrates reconstruction; published scores, rerun scores and future comparisons remain separate.

blocking_issues: Exact Figure 7e/Extended Data 6e–f numerical reference values and full observed-ratio grid are missing.
Seven session-file identities, top-neuron selection provenance and original fivefold sample identities are unbound.
Original mask seeds/replicate count, 100-step alignment and incomplete trailing-block semantics remain unresolved.
Current official code and the calibration scorer lack authenticated historical caller parity and a complete empirical reference.
Meaningful effect, dependence-aware uncertainty, finite feedback/compute budgets and protected execution are not fixed.

legacy.notes: Preserve missing-observation/scorer.py and its tests/specification. They check complete prediction/mask shape and CC arithmetic on generated fixtures, not authentic inference or a paper win. Its equal-replicate averaging and partial-block refusal are implementation conventions awaiting source reconciliation; no original grader or evidence is replaced.
